idea-plugin.name: Go New Project
idea-plugin.description:
Adds Go to the New Project dialog in the free IntelliJ IDEA, no paid Go plugin required.

  • Module path, Go version and a starter template (console app, library or HTTP service)
  • Writes go.mod, starter code with a test, .gitignore and a README
  • Detects installed Go SDKs from PATH, GOROOT and common install locations

Pair it with a gopls-based plugin for editing support.
